working_on.notes: All 4 performance fixes verified: Recomposition storm eliminated, RGB_565 RAM cut, Tab scroll preservation, Firestore redundant write prevention. AuditPerformanceFixTest PASSED 100%, debug APK successfully assembled (16MB).

Completed Phase 04: Local-First Firestore Favorites Sync, Profile header with Google Sign-In, and full-app guest-ready favorites persistence

errors_encountered.error: JdkImageTransform failed due to missing jlink in headless JRE 21
errors_encountered.solution: Downloaded Eclipse Temurin JDK 17 to ~/.jdks and configured org.gradle.java.home in gradle.properties

errors_encountered.error: Animation state reading in NativeStationDetailContent caused 60-120fps recomposition storm of entire bottom sheet
errors_encountered.solution: Extracted RotatingRefreshIcon into an isolated Composable so animated float is read only inside its own scope

decisions_made.reason: Prevents CPU/GPU recomposition storms during station detail refresh
Reduces bitmap memory consumption from 4 bytes/pixel to 2 bytes/pixel, cutting RAM usage by 50%
Preserves LazyColumn scroll position and UI state when toggling between NEARBY and FAVORITES tabs

decisions_made.decision: Skip redundant Cloud Firestore write in MERGE conflict resolution if in-sync
decisions_made.reason: Conserves Firebase Firestore Free Tier quota and eliminates unnecessary network latency
